title.zh: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
title.en: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade

current_state.zh: XRP Ledger 的修正版 PermissionDelegationV1_1 升级正处于14天激活倒计时中，若验证者支持维持在28/35以上，预计10月5日激活。
current_state.en: The XRP Ledger's revised PermissionDelegationV1_1 upgrade is in a 14-day activation countdown, expected to activate Oct. 5 if validator support remains at or above 28/35.

updates.what_changed_zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 修正版于9月21日进入14天激活倒计时，29/35验证者支持，预计10月5日激活；该版本修复了原版可被利用耗尽XRP余额的缺陷。
